description.value: Nu Chugh Beniz Campground sits within Ts'il?os Provincial Park on the shore of Chilko Lake, one of BC's largest and most striking high-elevation glacial lakes deep in the Chilcotin; the payoff is immense but the roughly 100 km of rough gravel road from Hanceville makes this one of the more demanding approaches in the region.
